mapper.select: SELECT c.id,c.tenant_id,c.section,c.enabled,c.revision,c.settings_json,c.verification_status FROM orbit_system_configuration c INNER JOIN orbit_tenant t ON t.id=c.tenant_id AND t.enabled=1 WHERE c.tenant_id=#{tenant} AND c.id=#{id} FOR SHARE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO orbit_analysis_gate(tenant_id,rule_id,entity_id) VALUES(#{tenant},#{rule},#{entity}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE generation=generation
mapper.select: SELECT generation,last_admitted_at FROM orbit_analysis_gate WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND rule_id=#{rule} AND entity_id=#{entity} FOR UPDATE
SELECT id,state,generation,input_hash,rule_id,rule_revision,schedule_slot FROM orbit_analysis_job WHERE tenant_id=#{tenant} AND dedupe_hash=#{hash}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO orbit_analysis_daily_quota(tenant_id,rule_id,entity_id,business_date) VALUES(#{job.tenantId},#{job.ruleId},#{job.entityId},#{job.businessDate}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE admitted_count=admitted_count
mapper.select: SELECT admitted_count FROM orbit_analysis_daily_quota WHERE tenant_id=#{job.tenantId} AND rule_id=#{job.ruleId} AND entity_id=#{job.entityId} AND business_date=#{job.businessDate} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO orbit_analysis_job_event(id,tenant_id,job_id,from_state,to_state,reason_code,created_at) SELECT UUID(),tenant_id,id,state,'SUPERSEDED','NEW_GENERATION',#{job.createdAt} FROM orbit_analysis_job WHERE tenant_id=#{job.tenantId} AND rule_id=#{job.ruleId} AND entity_id=#{job.entityId} AND id <> #{job.id} AND state IN ('QUEUED','RUNNING')
mapper.update: UPDATE orbit_analysis_job SET state='SUPERSEDED',revision=revision+1 WHERE tenant_id=#{job.tenantId} AND rule_id=#{job.ruleId} AND entity_id=#{job.entityId} AND id <> #{job.id} AND state IN ('QUEUED','RUNNING')
